1: /**
2:  * Copyright (c) Facebook, Inc. and its affiliates.

5:  * LICENSE file in the root directory of this source tree.
6:  */
7: 
8: import npmToYarn from 'npm-to-yarn';
9: import type {Code, Literal} from 'mdast';
10: // @ts-expect-error: TODO see https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/issues/49721
11: import type {MdxJsxFlowElement, MdxJsxAttribute} from 'mdast-util-mdx';
12: import type {Node, Parent} from 'unist';
13: // @ts-expect-error: TODO see https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/issues/49721
14: import type {Transformer} from 'unified';
15: 
16: // TODO as of April 2023, no way to import/re-export this ESM type easily :/
17: // This might change soon, likely after TS 5.2
18: // See https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/issues/49721#issuecomment-1517839391
19: // import type {Plugin} from 'unified';
20: // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars
21: type Plugin<T> = any; // TODO fix this asap
22: 
23: type KnownConverter = 'yarn' | 'pnpm';
24: 
25: type CustomConverter = [name: string, cb: (npmCode: string) => string];
26: 
27: type Converter = CustomConverter | KnownConverter;
28: 
29: type PluginOptions = {
30:   sync?: boolean;
31:   converters?: Converter[];
32: };
33: 
34: function createAttribute(
35:   attributeName: string,
36:   attributeValue: MdxJsxAttribute['value'],
37: ): MdxJsxAttribute {
38:   return {
39:     type: 'mdxJsxAttribute',
40:     name: attributeName,
41:     value: attributeValue,
42:   };
43: }
44: 
45: function createTabItem({
46:   code,
47:   node,
48:   value,
49:   label,
50: }: {
51:   code: string;
52:   node: Code;
53:   value: string;
54:   label?: string;
55: }): MdxJsxFlowElement {
56:   return {
57:     type: 'mdxJsxFlowElement',
58:     name: 'TabItem',
59:     attributes: [
60:       createAttribute('value', value),
61:       label && createAttribute('label', label),
62:     ].filter((attr): attr is MdxJsxAttribute => Boolean(attr)),
63:     children: [
64:       {
65:         type: node.type,
66:         lang: node.lang,
67:         value: code,
68:       },
69:     ],
70:   };
71: }
72: 
73: const transformNode = (
74:   node: Code,
75:   isSync: boolean,
76:   converters: Converter[],
77: ) => {
78:   const groupIdProp = isSync
79:     ? {
80:         type: 'mdxJsxAttribute',
81:         name: 'groupId',
82:         value: 'npm2yarn',
83:       }
84:     : undefined;
85:   const npmCode = node.value;
86: 
87:   function createConvertedTabItem(converter: Converter) {
88:     if (typeof converter === 'string') {
89:       return createTabItem({
90:         code: npmToYarn(npmCode, converter),
91:         node,
92:         value: converter,
93:         label: converter === 'yarn' ? 'Yarn' : converter,
94:       });
95:     }
96:     const [converterName, converterFn] = converter;
97:     return createTabItem({
98:       code: converterFn(npmCode),
99:       node,
100:       value: converterName,
101:     });
102:   }
103: 
104:   return [
105:     {
106:       type: 'mdxJsxFlowElement',
107:       name: 'Tabs',
108:       attributes: [groupIdProp].filter(Boolean),
109:       children: [
110:         createTabItem({code: npmCode, node, value: 'npm'}),
111:         ...converters.flatMap(createConvertedTabItem),
112:       ],
113:     },
114:   ] as any[];
115: };
116: 
117: const isMdxEsmLiteral = (node: Node): node is Literal =>
118:   node.type === 'mdxjsEsm';
119: // TODO legacy approximation, good-enough for now but not 100% accurate
120: const isTabsImport = (node: Node): boolean =>
121:   isMdxEsmLiteral(node) && node.value.includes('@theme/Tabs');
122: 
123: const isParent = (node: Node): node is Parent =>
124:   Array.isArray((node as Parent).children);
125: const isNpm2Yarn = (node: Node): node is Code =>
126:   node.type === 'code' && (node as Code).meta === 'npm2yarn';
127: 
128: function createImportNode() {
129:   return {
130:     type: 'mdxjsEsm',
131:     value:
132:       "import Tabs from '@theme/Tabs'\nimport TabItem from '@theme/TabItem'",
133:     data: {
134:       estree: {
135:         type: 'Program',
136:         body: [
137:           {
138:             type: 'ImportDeclaration',
139:             specifiers: [
140:               {
141:                 type: 'ImportDefaultSpecifier',
142:                 local: {type: 'Identifier', name: 'Tabs'},
143:               },
144:             ],
145:             source: {
146:               type: 'Literal',
147:               value: '@theme/Tabs',
148:               raw: "'@theme/Tabs'",
149:             },
150:           },
151:           {
152:             type: 'ImportDeclaration',
153:             specifiers: [
154:               {
155:                 type: 'ImportDefaultSpecifier',
156:                 local: {type: 'Identifier', name: 'TabItem'},
157:               },
158:             ],
159:             source: {
160:               type: 'Literal',
161:               value: '@theme/TabItem',
162:               raw: "'@theme/TabItem'",
163:             },
164:           },
165:         ],
166:         sourceType: 'module',
167:       },
168:     },
169:   };
170: }
171: 
172: const plugin: Plugin<[PluginOptions?]> = (options = {}): Transformer => {
173:   // @ts-expect-error: todo temporary
174:   const {sync = false, converters = ['yarn', 'pnpm']} = options;
175:   return async (root) => {
176:     const {visit} = await import('unist-util-visit');
177: 
178:     let transformed = false;
179:     let alreadyImported = false;
180: 
181:     visit(root, (node: Node) => {
182:       if (isTabsImport(node)) {
183:         alreadyImported = true;
184:       }
185: 
186:       if (isParent(node)) {
187:         let index = 0;
188:         while (index < node.children.length) {
189:           const child = node.children[index]!;
190:           if (isNpm2Yarn(child)) {
191:             const result = transformNode(child, sync, converters);
192:             node.children.splice(index, 1, ...result);
193:             index += result.length;
194:             transformed = true;
195:           } else {
196:             index += 1;
197:           }
198:         }
199:       }
200:     });
201: 
202:     if (transformed && !alreadyImported) {
203:       (root as Parent).children.unshift(createImportNode());
204:     }
205:   };
206: };
207: 
208: // To continue supporting `require('npm2yarn')` without the `.default` ㄟ(▔,▔)ㄏ
209: // TODO change to export default after migrating to ESM
210: export = plugin;

(End of file - total 210 lines)
</content>
